entities.name: Yüksel Şanlı
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Yüksel Şanlı is a Turkish former freestyle wrestler and coach. He represented Turkey at the 1996 Summer Olympics and 2000 Summer Olympics, and won a bronze medal at the 1999 World Wrestling Championships, a gold medal at the 1998 European Wrestling Championships, and gold medals at the 1997 Mediterranean Games and 2001 Mediterranean Games.
